answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose constant term encodes their private identity secret. Semaphore membership proofs and RLN nullifiers bind messages to that identity and epoch; exceeding the permitted messaging rate produces distinct polynomial shares, enabling Shamir interpolation to recover the secret. A verified violation triggers immediate collateral slashing. The karst, delta, and jade parameters can identify epoch-specific policy without exposing compliant agents’ identities.
